notes: Delete mirror of finance-replace-0018: removes the original (positive) functional property, so one code no longer excludes another (new_answer null, the model should say it cannot tell). The instances are rephrased around the original property ('Does it follow that X is not ...?'). Functional property of the new relation has_iso_4217_code. It holds without exception: ISO 4217 assigns each currency exactly one alphabetic code (JPY, GBP, EUR, ...); codes change only when a currency is replaced or redenominated (TRL to TRY), never two at once, hence 'at the same time' in every prompt. Fund codes such as USN or CHE/CHW are separate entries for separate units, and the instances avoid those currencies. The second values (YEN, STG) are not the ISO codes of these currencies, so the original answers are right both by the property and in the world; a model that still excludes them after the edit uses world knowledge or the old property. Near: an ISIN identifies one security (ISO 6166), so the reference no differs from the replace's new answer yes. Locality references are the logical answers.
